source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references. Crossref metadata independently confirmed the exact titles, years, and DOI identifiers for VeriSoft, DPOR, iterative context bounding, PCT, and optimal DPOR; ACM landing pages returned publisher HTTP 403 after DOI resolution. The USENIX CHESS paper and Microsoft technical report resolved directly and support systematic scheduling, reproduction, and bounded exploration. Current Coyote documentation resolved directly and supports controlled scheduling, systematic iterations, traces, replay, bounds, and external-concurrency limitations. Current loom 0.7.2 documentation resolved directly and supports deterministic permutation, model replacement types, preemption bounds, state reduction, and explicit relaxed-memory/model limitations. Claims are paraphrased and scoped; no inaccessible quotation is used.

evidence: Recomputed the local-order interleaving count as 4!/(2!2!) = 6.

numerical_recomputation.notes: The numerical result establishes only the finite lost-update teaching model. PCT probability language is attributed to the cited formulation and remains conditional on task, step, depth, independence, and control assumptions.

evidence: For two task-local sequences of lengths l_A and l_B, order-preserving shuffles are binomial (l_A+l_B)!/(l_A!l_B!); substituting two and two gives six.
Replay induction was rechecked: equal isolated state plus compatible enabled choice and deterministic transition yields equal successor state at every recorded choice.
The exhaustive-safety conclusion follows only after covering every modeled enabled alternative or a sound equivalence representative and checking phi at every classified leaf.

evidence: Replay induction explicitly requires equivalent initial state, compatible model digest, deterministic transition semantics, and recorded nondeterministic outcomes at each step.
Exhaustive safety requires complete finite prefix exploration, equivalent reset, correct assertions, and a sound reduction proof when schedules are omitted.
